acceptanceCriteria.text: Reconciliation is decoupled from the GET request path (background refresh and/or a freshness TTL exposed to clients) or performed with bounded concurrency instead of strictly sequential awaits.
`updateManagerSession` (or its caller) writes a session's projection only when the observed state actually differs from the stored one.
A benchmark exercising 10/100/500 sessions and concurrent dashboard clients measures external-call count, write count, and response latency before/after.

issue.title: fix: decouple dashboard session listing from synchronous unconditional reconciliation
